weekSummary: Pork on special across two cuts keeps costs down, with a chicken stew and two quick-cook meals filling the week

meals.name: Pork Chops with Apple and Sage
meals.description: Pan-seared pork chops with a quick apple and sage pan sauce, served with mashed potato
method: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain and mash with butter, milk, salt and pepper.
Season chops well. Heat oil in a heavy pan over high heat.
Sear chops 4 minutes per side until golden. Remove and rest.
In the same pan, cook sliced apple 2 minutes until golden.
Add stock, sage leaves and a knob of butter. Simmer 2 minutes to make a pan sauce.
Serve chops over mash with apple and pan sauce spooned over.

meals.name: Chicken and Kumara Stew
meals.description: Warming autumn stew with chicken thighs, kumara and cannellini beans in a herby broth
method: Brown chicken thighs in batches in a heavy pot until golden on both sides. Set aside.
Soften onion and garlic in the same pot 5 minutes.
Add cubed kumara, chicken stock and thyme. Bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to pot. Cover and cook 30 minutes until chicken is tender.
Stir in drained cannellini beans and season well.
Simmer uncovered 10 minutes until broth thickens slightly. Serve in deep bowls.

meals.name: Pork Mince San Choy Bow
meals.description: Light and fresh pork mince in crispy iceberg lettuce cups with water chestnuts
method: Carefully separate iceberg lettuce into cup-shaped leaves. Refrigerate to keep crisp.
Drain and roughly chop water chestnuts.
Cook pork mince in a hot wok with garlic and ginger until cooked through.
Add water chestnuts, soy sauce, oyster sauce and a splash of sesame oil. Toss well.
Remove from heat, stir in sliced spring onions.
Spoon into lettuce cups and serve immediately.

meals.name: Chicken Fried Noodles
meals.description: Wok-fried egg noodles with chicken, cabbage and a savoury soy glaze
method: Cook noodles per packet until just tender. Drain and toss with oil.
Slice chicken thinly across the grain. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir fry chicken in a hot wok 4 minutes until cooked. Remove.
Add shredded cabbage and garlic to wok. Stir fry 2 minutes.
Return chicken and noodles. Add soy and oyster sauce. Toss on high heat 2 minutes.
Serve with sliced spring onion and chilli if desired.

meals.name: Pork Spare Ribs with Roasted Vegetables
meals.description: Oven-baked spare ribs glazed with hoisin and honey, served with roasted broccoli and kumara
method: Preheat oven to 160°C. Mix hoisin, honey, soy sauce and garlic for the glaze.
Place ribs in a roasting tray, coat with half the glaze. Cover tightly with foil.
Roast 60 minutes until tender. Remove foil, brush with remaining glaze.
Increase oven to 200°C. Toss broccoli and cubed kumara in oil on a separate tray.
Roast everything uncovered 20 minutes until ribs are caramelised and vegetables are golden.
Serve ribs with roasted vegetables.
